title: Days Added Where a Certificate of Deposit Charge Is Booked Late
content:
Where a charge owed on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is booked well after the principal left, a further allowance of days is added to the days it runs over.

## 1. The allowance

A further allowance is added to those days: where the entry is booked more than 30 days after the principal left and the owner holds an active savings or money market account, the days the tier publishes as its minimum after funding are added; where the entry is booked more than 30 days after the principal left and the owner holds no such account, half of those minimum days, rounded down to a whole day, are added; where the entry is booked within 30 days of the day the principal left, nothing is added.

## 2. The figures

The days the tier publishes as its minimum after funding are 7 on every tier of the Certificates of Deposit line, and half of those, rounded down to a whole day, is 3. The account asked about is an active account of the bank's Savings & Money Market Accounts line, held by the owner; its balance is not asked about, only that such an account is held.

## 3. Condition and result

| Days between the day the principal left and the day the entry is booked | Owner holds an active savings or money market account | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| more than 30 | yes | 7 |
| more than 30 | no | 3 |
| 30 or fewer | yes | none |
| 30 or fewer | no | none |

The figure of 30 is a ceiling on the third grade rather than a floor on the first two: an entry booked on exactly the thirtieth day after the principal left is booked within 30 days, and nothing is added. On the thirty-first day the first two grades come into play.

## 4. Worked readings

| Principal left | Entry booked | Owner's deposit account | Days added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 25 April | active savings | none, 24 days being within 30 |
| 1 April | 1 May | active savings | none, 1 May being the thirtieth day after |
| 1 April | 2 May | active savings | 7, the thirty-first day being more than 30 |
| 1 April | 3 May | none | 3 |

The middle rows turn on the count of days and not on the calendar month: 1 May is the thirtieth day after 1 April, which is not more than 30, so nothing is added on that day; from 2 May onward the allowance applies, and which of the two allowances applies depends on whether such a deposit account is held.
